assertions.name: C4_the_SNF_routine_DISCRIMINATES_on_hand_built_matrices
assertions.source: three matrices -> three distinct normal forms [(1, 6), (1, 5), (2, 30)]; so a constant result below is a fact about the manifolds, not about this code

assertions.name: C1_edge_block_satisfies_the_NZ_SYMPLECTIC_identity
assertions.source: A_edge . B_edge^T is symmetric for all 16 knots — this is Neumann-Zagier's theorem, so the extracted matrices really are the NZ gluing datum

assertions.name: C2_cusp_rows_satisfy_the_1_CUSPED_NZ_relation
assertions.source: A_mu.B_lambda^T - A_lambda.B_mu^T = 2 for all knots — the meridian/longitude rows are correctly identified

assertions.name: C3_the_NZ_RANK_STRUCTURE_holds
assertions.source: rank(A|B) = N+1 and edge-block rank = N-1 for all knots, i.e. the one relation among the edge equations plus two cusp rows

assertions.name: C5_the_datum_AGREES_with_the_corpus_s_OWN_extractor
assertions.source: snappy's rectangular form and one_loop_torsion.nz_pair are related by (A,B) = (a,-b) EXACTLY, on every row of every knot (N up to 13). So this is not a second, possibly-divergent extraction — it is the same NZ datum the corpus already computes, in a stated convention

assertions.name: C6_the_SNF_is_INVARIANT_under_that_convention_flip
assertions.source: negating the B columns is unimodular, so SNF(A|-B) = SNF(A|B); verified per knot rather than assumed. The degeneracy below is therefore not an artifact of which convention was used

assertions.name: the_SNF_is_a_function_of_N_ALONE
assertions.source: (1)^N + (2) + (0) for every one of 16 knots, N=2..13; at each fixed N all knots give ONE SNF. The invariant carries no knot-theoretic information at all

assertions.name: five_PAIRWISE_NON_ISOMETRIC_HYPERBOLIC_knots_share_ONE_SNF
assertions.source: ['6_2', '7_3', '8_20', '9_42', '10_139'] are all hyperbolic and pairwise non-isometric (is_isometric_to, not a volume comparison) yet give the single SNF (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0) — so the degeneracy is NOT an artifact of including the non-hyperbolic 3_1

assertions.name: 3_1_and_4_1_share_an_SNF_but_have_DIFFERENT_certified_C
assertions.source: identical SNF (1, 1, 2, 0), C = 2 vs 3. CAVEAT, stated because it matters: 3_1 is not hyperbolic ('contains flat tetrahedra'), so a geometric dictionary may be undefined there. This instance CORROBORATES; the N=5 group above is what establishes the claim

assertions.name: CONSEQUENCE_the_dictionary_must_be_POLARIZATION_DEPENDENT
assertions.source: no GL(Z)xGL(Z)-invariant function of (A|B) can supply a node count separating 4_1 from 5_2, so the NZ->Q dictionary must read the matrix's actual entries in a fixed polarization. Scope-(a): DGG acts by Sp(2N,Z), finer than GLxGL, so such a construction is NOT excluded — D1-b is constrained at its entry, not refuted

description: D1-b (qou-q9ih) entry test, run before the NZ->Q dictionary is assembled. The Smith normal form of the Neumann-Zagier gluing matrix (A|B) is (1)^N + (2) + (0) for every one of 16 knots spanning N=2..13 tetrahedra -- a function of the tetrahedron count alone. Five pairwise non-isometric HYPERBOLIC knots at N=5 share it, so the degeneracy does not rest on the non-hyperbolic 3_1. Hence no GL(Z)xGL(Z)-invariant function of the NZ gluing matrix can supply D1-b's node count, which must separate 4_1 (3 connections) from 5_2 (4). The dictionary must read the matrix in a FIXED POLARIZATION. Scope-(a): the DGG construction acts by Sp(2N,Z), a strictly finer equivalence than GLxGL, so a polarization-dependent construction is NOT excluded and D1-b is NOT refuted. Neither input is re-derived: node counts come from dt_crossknot_connection_count_certified_probe, and the NZ datum is cross-checked against the corpus's own extractor one_loop_torsion.nz_pair, which agrees exactly as (A,B)=(a,-b). Six controls verify the datum is genuine NZ data (edge A.B^T symmetric; cusp pairing 2; rank N+1 and edge rank N-1; the nz_pair agreement; SNF invariance under that convention flip) and that the SNF routine discriminates. Exact integer arithmetic; distinctness by is_isometric_to, never by comparing volumes. Nothing wired; no fit.
